_README: Per-ticker story-DCF parameter overrides. Overlays on top of INDUSTRY_STORY_DEFAULTS in backend/services/story_dcf_engine.py. All numeric fields optional — provide only the ones you want to override. See StoryParams dataclass for full list.
_NOTE_2026_05_19_DAY6: Initial values approximate — operator must verify against actual investor presentations and reset reinvestment_rate / target_op_margin per ticker. Conservative defaults used where unsure.

PAYTM._notes: Payments scale economics; UPI revenue at thin margin but loan distribution + financial services higher margin. Op margin guide 18-25%.

POLICYBZR._notes: Insurance aggregator, recently profitable. Sustained operator's investment phase.

ZOMATO._notes: Food delivery + Blinkit. Higher growth + lower margin than payments. Blinkit Q-Comm reinvestment-heavy.

NAUKRI._notes: Info Edge — high op margin job platform business. Mature relative to other platforms.

NYKAA._notes: Beauty + fashion e-commerce. Thin retail margins.

MEESHO._notes: Long-tail e-commerce. High growth, low margin, capex-light but high marketing reinvestment.

SWIGGY._notes: Food delivery + Instamart, lower scale than ZOMATO but similar economics.

NUVAMA._notes: Wealth management — high op margin. Lower reinvestment vs other platforms.

GROWW._notes: Online broker — F&O + cash + mutual funds. Margin between Angel One and Zerodha (private).

ANGELONE._notes: Mature listed broker — F&O regulatory headwinds capped growth.
